Syddjurs is a Danish municipality that is tracked for clinical quality metrics within the national healthcare system [^src1]. Specifically, it is one of the 98 municipalities evaluated in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, which is published by the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. 

The municipality's significance in this corpus stems from its inclusion in the dataset for "Indicator 5," a metric that measures the prevention of ischemic stroke among atrial fibrillation patients through anticoagulant (AC) treatment [^src1]. This indicator relies on data from the DanStroke registry to benchmark local and national healthcare quality [^src1]. In the report's detailed municipal breakdown, Syddjurs is listed with specific statistical outcomes regarding stroke events and patient counts, serving as a localized data point for quality development and benchmarking [^src1].

Because the available evidence is limited to a single statistical table entry in the 2022–2023 annual report, no further historical timeline, specific relationships, or additional claims are documented for Syddjurs in this corpus.
